text: An audience is currently taking place which no one else is allowed to attend.
zh: 现在正在进行一场谒见，任何外人不得入内。

text: Baron Frestek and King Weynard III discuss strategic issues.
zh: 弗雷斯泰克男爵正与韦纳德三世国王商讨军政要务。

text: We were expressly told not to let anyone through until the audience was over.
zh: 我们接到明令，在谒见结束之前不得放任何人通过。

text: The baron and our King usually have different ideas, which often drags out their conversations.
zh: 男爵和我们的国王往往意见相左，他们的谈话常常拖得很久。

text:
It appears that Baron Frestek's audience already ended.
You are free to go into the castle.
zh:
看来弗雷斯泰克男爵的谒见已经结束了。
你可以进入城堡了。

text: You may now enter the throne room.
zh: 你现在可以进入王座厅了。

text:
However, stay respectful in there and do nothing stupid.
One does not speak to the king lightly.
zh:
不过，在里面放尊重些，别做蠢事。
同国王说话可不是儿戏。
